description: On Summerall Field at The Citadel; NMUSAF April 2016 loan list names the custodian AFROTC Det 765 The Citadel and confirms the serial; Aerial Visuals gives c/n 1145

At the south-west corner of Summerall Field at Lee Avenue and Jones Avenue; the HMdb marker AH-1 Cobra last revised February 2023 confirms the display and its dedication to Citadel aviators; Aerial Visuals gives c/n 24052 and a fix at 32.79625 -79.96019
